chunks: ʿAlī ibn Ibrāhīm, from his father, from Ibn Maḥbūb, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAmmār, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام ruled, regarding injuries of the body, that there is qisas in them, or the injured person may accept the compensation for the wound, and it is to be given to him.

key_terms.الْجِرَاحَةِ: the specific wound for which compensation is due
key_terms.الْمَجْرُوحُ: the injured person or wounded party
key_terms.قَضَى: issued a legal judgment or ruling

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on bodily injuries in Shia hadith: qisas or compensation?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a legal ruling from Amīr al-Muʾminīn عليه السلام concerning bodily injuries. It establishes that such cases are subject either to qisas or, if the injured party agrees, to financial compensation for the injury.
